request: Produced water treatment media for ADNOC operations in UAE oil fields. The wastewater contains 15-25 g/L total dissolved solids (TDS), 2-5 mg/L total oil and grease (TOG), 200-500 ppm sulfide, and colloidal particles. The pretreatment material must reduce oil/grease to <1 ppm for downstream membrane unit, remove sulfide to <0.1 ppm to prevent corrosion, and withstand high salinity (NaCl-dominated). Backwash regeneration in 2-3 hours enables continuous operation.

Hydrocarbon removal media for North Sea offshore platform produced water. The feed stream contains crude oil, paraffins, asphaltenes, and emulsified water at 40-60°C. Design a high-capacity adsorbent using activated carbon and polymeric resin blend to achieve <5 ppm residual hydrocarbon and stable performance through 50+ backwash cycles. The material must resist biofouling and be compatible with seawater disposal regulations.

Sulfide control material for preventing corrosion in produced water reinjection systems. The wastewater stream from gas production contains 50-200 ppm H2S and CO2 from the reservoir. The adsorbent must: (1) reduce H2S to <2 ppm, (2) withstand pH 5.5-6.5, (3) avoid iron sulfide precipitation that could foul injection wells, and (4) maintain performance through regeneration with air oxidation at 60°C.

Anti-fouling pretreatment for membrane feed in an oilfield water reuse system. The produced water contains 1.5-3.0 g/L TOC (dissolved organics), 0.5-2 mg/L oil emulsion, and 3-5 µm suspended solids. Design a composite media combining coagulation aid, activated carbon, and ion-exchange resin to achieve <100 ppm TOC and <0.5 mg/L turbidity to protect downstream RO and NF membranes.

Multi-stage produced water treatment train material for ultra-low discharge operations. Stage 1 removes bulk oil (<5 mg/L target), Stage 2 removes dissolved organics (<100 ppm TOC), and Stage 3 polishes for trace metals and sulfide (<0.1 ppm). Each stage uses different activated carbon grades optimized for the target pollutant. Performance must meet 'produced water is drinking quality' standards for inland discharge.

Gulf conditions produced water treatment: high salinity (45-55 g/L NaCl), elevated temperature (45-50°C), sulfide (100-300 ppm), and TOC (1-3 g/L). The pretreatment media must tolerate thermal cycling (ambient to 50°C repeatedly), resist osmotic stress, and achieve stable performance for injection into formation with <5000 ppm total dissolved solids.

Biofilm-resistant pretreatment media for treating produced water in remote offshore operations where maintenance intervals exceed 6 months. The material must inhibit bacterial colonization (SRB, APB) that could cause biofouling and hydrogen sulfide generation. Design using antimicrobial nanoparticles (ZnO, copper) immobilized on activated carbon with mechanical backwash capability.

Modular cartridge-based produced water pretreatment for equipment skid deployment. Each cartridge processes 5-10 bbl/day, uses 2-stage media (coarse followed by fine), enables field-level media exchange without specialist training, and integrates pressure monitoring for backwash sequencing. Total dissolved solids (TDS) pass-through target <2000 ppm for potable reuse in remote areas.
